page.layout: Title page: an ornamental band at the top; below it the title "DE JURAMENTI OBLIGATIONE." with "Prælectio Prima.", all centred. Then the reference "Num. 30: 3." and a four-line italic motto. Then the centred heading "SUMMARIUM." and a numbered list of eight items, the eighth cut off at the foot. Signature "B" at the lower left, with no catchword and no running head or page number.

l.i: Vir si voverit votum, aut si juraverit jura-
suam, non polluet verbum suum, secundum
omne quod egressum est ex ore suo, faciet.

main_text.l: 7. Dati juramenti definitio continet 4 causarum genera.

page.notes: The ornamental band at the top and the small mark at the upper right edge are not text. The eighth summary item is cut off at the foot of the page; only "Jura-" is visible. The hyphen in "jura-mentum" is printed at the line end. In the motto, the u in "juraverit" and "jura-mentum" is printed with a dot or macron and is read as u. The "4" in item 7 is printed as a numeral.
